inspection_provenance.note: Only the four hooks directly relevant to R21 test scope were fully inspected. Other hooks require separate analysis.

emergency_users_hardening.probe_proof: T-FIELD-ROLE-REJECT (§24) — ordinary user PATCH role=admin → expect 403
emergency_users_hardening.behavior: Blocks role changes in users collection PATCH requests for non-superadmin callers. Logs blocked events without PII. $app.save() calls bypass this hook.
r21_notes: D21-9: probe classified as behavioral (no HTTP route); previously UNRESOLVED
Does not block phone_verified (not in scope). Guard hook handles that.

auth_whatsapp_otp.behavior: Generates 6-digit OTP, stores in phone_otps (is_used=false), sends via Meta Cloud API. On verify: marks is_used=true.
auth_whatsapp_otp.isolated_env: NOT deployed. OTP test adapter replaces it for isolated testing.

push_broadcast.probe_expected: 400 (title and message are required — never reaches OneSignal)
push_broadcast.external_dependency: OneSignal API (not contacted by safe probe with empty body)
push_broadcast.behavior: Broadcasts push notifications via OneSignal. Requires onesignal_app_id and onesignal_api_key in lms_settings.

whatsapp.probe_expected: 200 (returns configured/unconfigured status) or 401/403 if auth issue
whatsapp.external_dependency: NONE for GET config probe (reads lms_settings only)
whatsapp.behavior: Manages WhatsApp credential config (phone_number_id, access_token, api_version) in lms_settings.

otp_test_adapter.type: LOCAL TEST ONLY — NOT FOR PRODUCTION
otp_test_adapter.lifecycle: pending_send → (local provider fixture) → sent_active (success) | send_failed (failure) → consumed (after verify)
otp_test_adapter.loopback_enforcement: 127.x.x.x or [::1]:port or ::1 only (D21-8: correct IPv6 parsing)
